# DKsequence

> DKsequence makes Android apps (games, tools, learning and lifestyle). Each app has a description, screenshots, a promo video and a Google Play link.

## App directory
- [DKsequence Apps (English)](https://dksequence.com/apps/): all apps by genre
- [DKsequence 앱 모음 (한국어)](https://dksequence.com/apps/ko/): 장르별 전체 앱

## Apps
- [My Life Time](https://dksequence.com/apps/mylifetime/): A life countdown clock — see the time you have left in hours, minutes, seconds. (Lifestyle)
